title: Print a greeting
instructions:
Write a program that prints exactly these two lines:

```text
Hello, Python
42
```

Let Python calculate the second line (use `40 + 2`) instead of typing the answer.

title: First program check
instructions: Three quick questions about what you just read.

questions.explanation: The quotation marks make it text, so Python prints it unchanged. print(2 + 2) would print 4.
Python is case sensitive, so Print is a different, undefined name: NameError.

questions.prompt: What is a comment in Python?
options: A line Python ignores, written for humans
questions.explanation: Everything after # on a line is ignored by Python. Comments are notes for people.
